CustomField.description: Shows where this Lead has been created: Shopify (Create Shopify), NetSuite (Create NetSuite), both, or not yet. Read-only formula over Shopify Created and NetSuite Created.
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(Shopify_Created__c, NetSuite_Created__c), "Shopify & NetSuite", IF(Shopify_Created__c, "Shopify", IF(NetSuite_Created__c, "NetSuite", "Not created")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where this Lead has been created: Shopify, NetSuite, both, or not created yet.
CustomField.label: Created In
